The United States military on Friday announced it had fired at a ship in the Gulf of Oman that it said was violating Washington's blockade of Iranian ports . A US aircraft fired "precision munitions" in the stern of the Palau-flagged Pacific Archer, US Central Command (CENTCOM), said, adding that it "continues to strictly enforce the [US] blockade." The statement said that "the ship's propulsion was ultimately disabled" and stressed that "the civilian crew was unharmed." It said that the ship had left the Iranian port of Bandar Abbas. The US blockade has disabled six ships and redirected 158 others. Washington launched its blockade of Iranian ports in mid-July following the collapse of an agreement with Tehran. The war broke out in February after the US and Israel launched strikes on Iran , which prompted Tehran to impose its own blockade on the Strait of Hormuz . Meanwhile, Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador after a Thursday drone strike killed two Italian technicians at a Kuwaiti military site. A Kuwaiti citizen and a Pakistani citizen were also injured and hospitalized in the attack. clusters.text: Two American Airlines Boeing 737s clipped wings while taxiing for departure at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) on Friday, as per the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). No injuries were reported.The incident comes as roughly 6 million Americans are projected to fly domestically during the Thanksgiving travel period, according to AAA.According to the FAA, American Airlines flight 638, bound for Dallas, clipped the wing of flight 2152, bound for Chicago, at around 5:10pm ET, as per 7News. Both planes were taxiing to take off at the time.The pilot of flight 638 told air traffic controllers that the plane's wing had come in contact with flight 2152, which was next in line. "Yes sir, we are slightly over the hold short line and unfortunately we swapped paint with the American behind us, next to us," the pilot told controllers, as per CNN. Broken winglet and flight delaysAs per CNN, the winglet, the outermost part of the wing that curves up, broke off one of the planes, according to the air traffic control audio. "We got debris off our right… the whole winglet is there," one pilot told the tower.Airport workers later recovered the broken winglet, after which both planes were able to taxi to their gates.The control tower also told another plane arriving at the airport to abort its landing. And other incoming flights were warned about possible delays.What happens nextThe FAA said it will investigate the incident. American Airlines told CNN that both planes have been removed from service for inspection."We apologize to our customers for the inconvenience and are working to get them on their way as soon as possible," the airline said.The collision happened just off Runway 19, the longest runway at DCA and one of the busiest in the country.In January 2025, the area near the airport was the site of the deadliest commercial aviation accident in the US in decades. An American Airlines regional jet that was preparing to land and a US Army helicopter collided, killing 67 people.

clusters.text: The Golden State Warriors have ruled Stephen Curry out for at least the next three games as he continues rehabilitating a torn oblique. While the organization confirmed Friday that Curry is making encouraging progress and advancing to individual on-court work in San Francisco with lead medical decision-maker Rick Celebrini, his next official reevaluation is scheduled for Wednesday — exactly three weeks after he sustained the injury against Houston on Nov. 11. The extended timeline keeps Curry sidelined for Friday’s road matchup in Portland, Sunday’s home clash against the LA Clippers, and Tuesday’s tilt against the Utah Jazz. Golden State has gone 2-4 in his absence, stumbling through an 0-5 road trip before stabilizing with back-to-back home victories over Boston and Sacramento. With Curry’s 27.8 points per game still off the floor, Brandin Podziemski, De’Anthony Melton, Brandon Williams, and LJ Cryer will continue carrying heavy backcourt responsibilities, while rookie Yaxel Lendeborg will continue to be at the top of the priority list on opponents’ scouting reports.

Polls opened across its 22 cities and counties at 8am (00:00 GMT) on Saturday and closed at 4pm (08:00 GMT), with results expected early in the evening. About 11,000 positions were at stake in the “nine-in-one” elections, named for the nine categories of local government posts contested. A key contest was for the mayor of the capital, Taipei, a traditional stronghold of the opposition Kuomintang (KMT). Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the KMT, who won by a double-digit margin in the last election and was seen as a possible future presidential candidate, faced a strong challenge from Puma Shen of the governing Democratic Progressive Party (DPP). Shen is an academic-turned-lawmaker and an expert on China’s information warfare . China has denounced him, and Chinese police say he is wanted for “separatism”. clusters.snippet: Pirelli is evaluating if further precautions are needed for the Qatar Grand Prix after Friday practice.
clusters.text: Despite the highest front tyre pressures of the season and a maximum stint length already in place, Pirelli is evaluating if further precautions are needed for the Qatar Grand Prix after Friday practice served up “surprise after surprise.” The Lusail circuit is already the most challenging of the season for tyres, but the evidence from the first day of track running has shown graining, wear and degradation to be at higher levels than anticipated pre-event. It is suspected this has been caused by a more weathered track surface and the reduced downforce levels of the 2026 cars that are causing sliding. On a weekend where there is a much-talked-about 27-lap maximum stint length laid down for each set of tyres, Pirelli has already seen evidence of the most abused front-left sets hitting 100% wear in localised areas after just 15 laps of running on Friday. Pirelli’s chief engineer Simone Berra said: “It's quite impressive the surprises that this circuit gives to us every time they come here.” Graining has been encountered on all three compounds - with it particularly aggressive on the C2 and C3. This is accelerating the wear in two specific areas of the tyre - near the inside shoulder and then on the very outside shoulder. clusters.text: Lorenzo Musetti and Andrea Vavassori beat Jiri Lehecka and Tomas Machac 3-6, 6-1, 7-6 (4) in the deciding doubles to send Italy into the Davis Cup final in Bologna. Musetti had earlier beaten Jakub Mensik in singles. Italy reached the Davis Cup final on Friday in Bologna by beating Czechia 2-1. Lorenzo Musetti and Andrea Vavassori beat Jiri Lehecka and Tomas Machac 3-6, 6-1, 7-6 (4) in 1 hour 55 minutes in the deciding doubles. Italy will play Great Britain or Spain in Sunday’s final. Musetti won both his matches of the day. The world No. 27 first gave Italy the lead by beating Jakub Mensik , the world No. 15, 6-3, 6-4 in 1 hour 26 minutes. Lehecka then levelled the tie by beating Flavio Cobolli 6-2, 1-6, 6-3 in 1 hour 40 minutes. The Czechs won the first set and twice came within one point of serving for the match in the third. Italy then won the tie-break 7-4. The Italians hit nine aces to five, won 88% of their first-serve points (44 of 50) against 66% for the Czechs (36 of 55) and converted both their break points. “I think the most important thing is that I’m alive,” Italy captain Filippo Volandri said with a smile. “We were ready to die on court.” On match point, Vavassori served, the Czechs barely got the ball back, and Musetti put away an easy volley. He then jumped into the arms of Matteo Berrettini . For everyone in Bologna, the day sealed the reconciliation between Musetti and Berrettini. Berrettini had strongly supported Musetti during his singles against Mensik. Musetti also had a score to settle in doubles. “Last time we played together was such a long time ago, and I didn’t perform well, have to say,” he said of his partnership with Vavassori. “I wanted to take revenge on that also.” Czechia captain Tomas Berdych had picked Lehecka and Machac for the doubles rather than a specialist pairing. “When I saw the possibility who might come from the Italian team, I just felt that I want to put some, I don’t know how to call it, maybe an X factor in it, that there would be someone playing more aggressive, put little bit more pressure,” he said. “I stay and I stick with the decision that I made because the guys just put incredible effort there. clusters.title: Marandi seeks probe into ‘custodial torture’ of journalist
clusters.text: Ranchi: Leader of opposition in the assembly Babulal Marandi on Friday sought an independent judicial probe into allegations that Simdega police tortured YouTube journalist Abhishek Bharti in custody.The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), meanwhile, has taken cognisance of a complaint concerning the POCSO case involving a 14-year-old tribal girl and the arrest of a journalist who reported on it.Late on Friday, Simdega police rejected the assault allegations, saying all mandatory legal procedures were followed. “He was produced before the competent court and sent directly to judicial custody at Simdega district jail.”Bharti, booked in a counter FIR linked to a sexual assault case involving Congress MLA Bhushan Bara, was arrested in Jamshedpur on Thursday. His father, journalist Sampoornanand Bharti, alleged custodial torture.Writing to the NHRC, Marandi alleged police assaulted Bharti intermittently from the night of Nov 25 until around 3 pm on Nov 26 to pressure him into making a statement in court as desired by police.He sought preservation of CCTV footage, police station diaries, custody records and hospital documents, besides suo motu cognisance by the Jharkhand high court.The NHRC bench, presided over by member Priyank Kanoongo, issued notices to Jharkhand DGP and chief secretary, seeking an action taken report within two weeks. The complaint also flagged a raid on a news organisation’s office and seizure of journalistic equipment. The notices were issued under Section 12 of the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, for inquiry into the allegations.The case stems from the girl’s Nov 14 FIR accusing Bara of rape. A counter FIR accused Bharti and Dilip Tirkey of abducting her from Simdega and coaxing her to lodge a false case against the MLA. She later turned hostile before a magistrate in Ranchi. Tirkey had been arrested earlier. Bara has denied the allegations.Stay updated with the latest Ranchi news. Download the TOI App.

clusters.title: Allahabad HC cancels UPPCS 2025 prelims results; mains and interview process to be held afresh
also: Allahabad High Court Cancels UPPCS 2025 Prelims Results; Mains and Interview Process to be Held Afresh
clusters.text: Prayagraj ( Uttar Pradesh ) [India], November 27 (ANI): The Allahabad High Court has directed the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission ( UPPSC ) to declare the results of the UPPCS-2025 Preliminary Examination afresh. The court directed the UPPSC to prepare a revised merit list on the basis of reservation and merit. The court ordered that candidates belonging to reserved categories who have scored more marks than the last selected candidate in the unreserved category be included in the open category. The court has also sought details of the marks obtained by candidates selected category-wise from the Commission. The Mains Examination will now be conducted afresh on the basis of the revised merit list. Candidates will be called for interviews on the basis of the new Mains Examination results. The interview process will also be conducted afresh. According to the candidates' counsel, Abhishek Shukla, the Preliminary Examination will not be held again. The revised results will be declared on the basis of the marks obtained in the examination already conducted. Candidates belonging to reserved categories had filed a petition before the High Court, alleging that despite securing higher marks, they were not given the benefit of selection under the open category. The petitioners argued that the open category is not reserved for any particular class and that candidates from all categories should be accommodated in it on the basis of merit. A total of 814 posts are to be filled through UPPCS-2025 . As many as 6,26,387 candidates had applied for the Preliminary Examination, while 2,65,270 candidates appeared in the examination. On the basis of the Preliminary Examination, 11,727 candidates were declared successful for the Mains Examination. A total of 10,284 candidates appeared in the Mains Examination, out of whom 2,297 candidates were declared successful for the interview. A single-judge bench of Justice Manish Kumar Nigam pronounced the order on the petition filed by candidates belonging to reserved categories. With the revised merit list, the entire selection process for UPPCS-2025 will now proceed afresh. (ANI)

clusters.title: RBI Brings 25 Card Payment Rules Together: What Changes For Customers?
clusters.text: Stay ahead with our breaking stories and exclusive coverage prioritized on Google. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has brought 25 separate instructions governing debit, credit and prepaid card transactions under one regulatory framework, making it easier for banks and payment companies to follow rules designed to protect customers from fraud and unauthorised transactions. The central bank issued the Reserve Bank of India (Digital Payments – Card-based Transaction) Directions, 2026, on Friday, November 27. The directions took effect immediately and cover card authentication, security controls, tokenisation, online payments and charges collected from merchants. For ordinary cardholders, however, the announcement does not introduce new transaction limits or require them to change how they use their cards. Instead, the RBI has consolidated instructions issued between 2011 and 2024, replacing 25 earlier circulars while retaining existing protections. FCRF Launches Certified Chief Risk Officer (CRO) Program for India’s Risk Leaders One of the important provisions concerns the ability of customers to manage how their cards are used. Banks must continue providing facilities that allow cardholders to enable or disable different transaction channels, including online purchases, international payments and contactless transactions. Customers must also be able to modify transaction limits according to their needs. For example, someone who uses a debit card only for domestic purchases can keep international transactions disabled to reduce the possibility of misuse. The consolidated framework also retains existing security requirements for chip-based cards and authentication at payment terminals. Eligible contactless transactions of up to ₹5,000 continue to qualify for the existing exemption from additional authentication. This does not mean every transaction below that amount will automatically proceed without further verification. Applicable conditions and security checks still matter. The RBI has also retained provisions concerning customers’ choice of credit-card networks. Eligible card issuers must offer customers the option to select among available card networks. However, the requirement does not apply to issuers with 10 lakh or fewer active cards or those operating their own authorised networks.
